verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲ‍ֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ bih·yō·w·ṯōw bə·miḏ·bar yə·hū·ḏāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ê·lî ’at·tāh ’ăša·ḥă·re·kā ṣā·mə·’āh lə·ḵā nap̄·šî kā·mah lə·ḵā ḇə·śā·rî bə·’e·reṣ- ṣî·yāh wə·‘ā·yêp̄ bə·lî- mā·yim
verses.literal: A Psalm of David when he was in the Wilderness of Judah O God You are my God Earnestly I seek You my soul thirsts for You My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory

verses.original: כִּי־ ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּךָ מֵֽחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṭō·wḇ ḥas·də·ḵā mê·ḥay·yîm śə·p̄ā·ṯay yə·šab·bə·ḥū·nə·ḵā
verses.literal: Because Your loving devotion is better than life my lips will glorify You

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי׃
verses.literal: So I will bless You as long as I live in Your name I will lift my hands

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־ פִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏe·šen tiś·ba‘ nap̄·šî wə·śip̄·ṯê rə·nā·nō·wṯ yə·hal·lel- pî
verses.literal: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods with joyful lips my mouth will praise You

verses.original: אִם־ זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל־ יְצוּעָ֑י בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: When I remember You on my bed I think of You through the watches of the night

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
verses.literal: For You are my help I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings

verses.original: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: My soul clings to You Your right hand upholds me

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh lə·šō·w·’āh yə·ḇaq·šū nap̄·šî yā·ḇō·’ū bə·ṯaḥ·tî·yō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth

verses.original: יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yag·gî·ru·hū ‘al- yə·ḏê- ḥā·reḇ mə·nāṯ šu·‘ā·lîm yih·yū
verses.literal: They will fall to the power of the sword they will become a portion for foxes

verses.original: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֪ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ yiś·maḥ bê·lō·hîm yiṯ·hal·lêl kāl- han·niš·bā‘ bōw kî yis·sā·ḵêr pî ḏō·wḇ·rê- šā·qer
verses.literal: But the king will rejoice in God all who swear by Him will exult for the mouths of liars . . . will be shut
